name: Nugget Doom [anylinux]
description:
Nugget Doom is an enhanced Doom source port forked from Woof! that introduces user-friendly features, visual customization, and quality-of-life additions while maintaining strict demo compatibility.

Features:
- Modernized OpenGL and software rendering supporting widescreen aspect ratios
- Flexible HUD customization, crosshairs, and extended automap statistics
- Full compatibility with classic Doom, Doom II, Final Doom, and Boom/MBF21 mods
- Smooth uncapped framerate option with precise interpolation
- Modern controller, mouse-look, and keyboard input customization

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
